To find the characteristic polynomial of the given matrix, we need to compute the determinant of the matrix \( A - \lambda I \), where \( A \) is the given matrix and \( I \) is the identity matrix.

Given matrix \( A \):
\[
A = \begin{pmatrix}
-4 & -13 & 10 \\
-9 & 10 & 4 \\
12 & -5 & -14
\end{pmatrix}
\]

The matrix \( A - \lambda I \) is:
\[
A - \lambda I = \begin{pmatrix}
-4 - \lambda & -13 & 10 \\
-9 & 10 - \lambda & 4 \\
12 & -5 & -14 - \lambda
\end{pmatrix}
\]

The characteristic polynomial \( f(\lambda) \) is the determinant of \( A - \lambda I \):
\[
f(\lambda) = \det \begin{pmatrix}
-4 - \lambda & -13 & 10 \\
-9 & 10 - \lambda & 4 \\
12 & -5 & -14 - \lambda
\end{pmatrix}
\]

We can expand this determinant using the first row:
\[
f(\lambda) = (-4 - \lambda) \det \begin{pmatrix}
10 - \lambda & 4 \\
-5 & -14 - \lambda
\end{pmatrix}
- (-13) \det \begin{pmatrix}
-9 & 4 \\
12 & -14 - \lambda
\end{pmatrix}
+ 10 \det \begin{pmatrix}
-9 & 10 - \lambda \\
12 & -5
\end{pmatrix}
\]

Calculating each of the 2x2 determinants:
\[
\det \begin{pmatrix}
10 - \lambda & 4 \\
-5 & -14 - \lambda
\end{pmatrix} = (10 - \lambda)(-14 - \lambda) - (4)(-5) = \lambda^2 + 4\lambda - 140 + 5\lambda + 20 = \lambda^2 + 9\lambda - 120
\]

\[
\det \begin{pmatrix}
-9 & 4 \\
12 & -14 - \lambda
\end{pmatrix} = (-9)(-14 - \lambda) - (4)(12) = 126 + 9\lambda - 48 = 9\lambda + 78
\]

\[
\det \begin{pmatrix}
-9 & 10 - \lambda \\
12 & -5
\end{pmatrix} = (-9)(-5) - (10 - \lambda)(12) = 45 - 120 + 12\lambda = 12\lambda - 75
\]

Substituting these back into the expression for \( f(\lambda) \):
\[
f(\lambda) = (-4 - \lambda)(\lambda^2 + 9\lambda - 120) + 13(9\lambda + 78) + 10(12\lambda - 75)
\]

Expanding and simplifying:
\[
f(\lambda) = (-4 - \lambda)(\lambda^2 + 9\lambda - 120) + 117\lambda + 1014 + 120\lambda - 750
\]

\[
f(\lambda) = -4\lambda^2 - 36\lambda + 480 - \lambda^3 - 9\lambda^2 + 120\lambda + 117\lambda + 1014 + 120\lambda - 750
\]

\[
f(\lambda) = -\lambda^3 - 13\lambda^2 + 361\lambda + 744
\]

Thus, the characteristic polynomial is:
\[
\boxed{-\lambda^3 - 13\lambda^2 + 361\lambda + 744}
\]
